data.name: Wretched Scavenged Isles
data.description:
Ahoy, filthy seadogs! Churning seas of undead despair, eatin' ya alive whilst begging and dragging yer water-logged corpses off to sea in search of an almost bearable life, yet nothin' awaits ya surer than the scourge of rottin' death, deep below the waves...

Created to play Mork Borg/Pirate Borg
